DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 最後に鍵を見た場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where did you last see your keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が駅で落としたはずと言ったので、駅だと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の駅紛失推測を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend said I must have dropped them at the station, so I think it was there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Relay your friend’s guess that the keys were lost at the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご友人は落とすところを見たのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did your friend see you drop them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、駅で荷物を出したからそう思ったそうです。見たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人は落下を目撃していないと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. They thought so because I took things out of my bag there. They did not actually see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clarify that your friend did not witness the keys being dropped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身が鍵を確かめた最後の場所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Where did you personally last check that you had the keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家を出るときに手に持っていました。それ以降は確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人が最後に鍵を確認した自宅出発時を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I held them when leaving home. I have not checked since then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the last time you personally checked was when leaving home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 駅や移動の経路も、可能性として伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also ask about the station and your route as possibilities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、駅で落としたと断定せず、駅で荷物を開けたことと最後の確認を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅の荷物開封と紛失場所断定を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will separate opening my bag at the station from my last confirmed sighting, without stating that I dropped them there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish opening your bag at the station from determining where the keys were lost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鍵の特徴はわかりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三本の鍵が青い輪に付いています。友人の推測は推測として、届け出に説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鍵の特徴と推測扱いの記録を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Three keys on a blue ring. I would like my friend’s guess recorded in the report as a guess.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the keys and ask that the guess be recorded as a guess. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。最後の確認、移動の経過、推測を区別して記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will distinguish the last confirmed sighting, your movements and guesses in the record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この荷物を受け取られたいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to collect this parcel, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、家にあったので私の物だと思いましたが、宛名は同居人でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票は同居人宛てで本人と誤解したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The notice was at home, so I thought it was mine, but it is addressed to my housemate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you mistook the delivery notice for your own, but it is addressed to your housemate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人宛てではないのですね。同居人の方は受け取りを頼まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it is not addressed to you. Has your housemate asked you to collect it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ頼まれていません。一緒に住んでいれば、自由に受け取れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼未確認で同居なら自由受取と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought living together meant I could collect it freely.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not been asked and thought sharing a home allowed unrestricted collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 代理の扱いと必要な確認を担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain collection by a representative and the checks needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。先に本人へ連絡し、希望しているか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同居人の希望を先に確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will contact my housemate first and check whether they want me to do it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check your housemate’s wishes first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人の確認資料なども、条件を確認してから準備してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the conditions before preparing their identification or other documents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、同居人の書類を勝手に持ち出さず、何が必要かを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人書類を無断で持出さず条件を本人へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not take their documents without permission; I will tell them what is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell them the requirements without taking their documents without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は本人の受取方法も案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can also explain how they can collect it themselves today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それもお願いします。私が受け取る前提だけでなく、本人が来る方法と比較したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代理だけでなく本人受取も比較したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I want to compare that with my collecting it, rather than assume I will do it for them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to compare personal collection with collection by a representative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。宛名の方の希望を確認し、受取方法を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please confirm the addressee’s wishes before choosing a collection method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードをなくされたとのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you reporting a lost card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: アプリでカードが見えなくなりました。現物は財布にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: アプリ非表示で現物は手元と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The card has disappeared from the app. The physical card is in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the card is not displayed in the app but you still have the physical card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現物の紛失ではなく、画面の表示についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So this is about the display, not losing the physical card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、電話ではなくしたと言いましたが、物を落としたのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紛失という電話説明を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I said I had lost it on the phone, but I have not dropped the actual card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your telephone explanation that the card was lost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の表示とカードの状態を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the current display and card status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。表示がないから停止済みとか解約済みとは決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 非表示を停止や解約と断定していないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I have not assumed that no display means the card is suspended or canceled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not concluded that a missing display means suspension or cancellation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 昨日から変わった操作はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you done anything differently since yesterday?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯を替え、アプリを入れ直しました。ただ、その操作が原因だとはまだわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 端末変更と再導入を原因未確定の経過として説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I changed phones and reinstalled the app. But I do not yet know whether that caused it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the phone change and reinstallation as events, not a confirmed cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へその経過を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that sequence of events to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、別のアカウントを新しく作る前に、本人の登録と表示の確認方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新規登録前に本人登録と表示確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Before making another new account, I would like to ask how to check my own registration and the display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to check your registration and display before creating a new account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現物の有無、端末の変更、登録状況を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check physical possession, the phone change and registration status separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 購入した商品はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the product you bought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家にあります。同じ棚から一つ取って、これで説明しようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入現物は自宅で別棚商品を説明用に取ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is at home. I took one from the same shelf so I could use it to explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your purchase is at home and you took a different shelf item to explain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これはまだお買い上げでない別の商品ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a different item that you have not bought yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。元の商品と同じかどうかも、容量を見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未購入の別物で容量も未照合と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I had not even compared the capacity to see whether it matches my original item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is a different unpurchased item and its capacity is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入品の写真やレシートはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have photos of your purchase or a receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。説明用に売り場の商品を開けず、写真とレシートを見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 売場商品を開封せず写真とレシートを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will show the photos and receipt without opening the shelf item to explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show photos and the receipt without opening the shop item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元の商品には、どのような状態がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: What was the condition of the original product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ふたの縁が欠けていました。いつ欠けたかはわからないので、状態を担当へ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入品のふた欠けと発生時期不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The rim of its lid was chipped. I do not know when it happened, so I want to discuss its condition with the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention the purchased lid’s chip and that you do not know when it occurred. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持参が必要かも担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also check whether you need to bring it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今取った新商品を交換済みの物として持ち帰らず、店へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当相談を求め新商品を交換済みとして持ち帰らないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will return this new item to the shop instead of taking it home as if an exchange had been completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for staff assistance and say you will not take the new product home as an exchanged item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。売り場の商品と購入品を分けて、相談の方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will distinguish the shelf item from your purchase and explain how to seek assistance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入口へ戻る道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the way back to the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、一周の道を歩いたはずなのに、入口が見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一周したつもりで入口が見つからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought I had followed the loop, but I cannot find the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought you completed the loop but cannot find the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 途中で分岐を曲がりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you turn at a junction along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池への矢印で曲がりました。一周の道の続きだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池への分岐を一周の続きと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I followed an arrow toward the pond. I thought it was part of the loop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the pond branch for the continuation of the loop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 池への道と一周の経路を分けて現在地を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us identify your location and distinguish the pond path from the loop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。そのまま歩けば戻ると決めず、いったん案内板を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歩き続けず現在地と案内板確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Instead of assuming I will get back by continuing, I would like to stop and check a map board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check your location and the information board rather than keep walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の場所から元の入口へ戻る道を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the route from here back to your original entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩き疲れたので、戻る途中のベンチも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 疲れがあり帰路の休憩所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am tired from walking, so please also tell me about benches on the way back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you are tired and ask about resting places on the return route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口へ戻る短い道はこちらです。途中にベンチがあるので、休みながら戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is a short route back to the entrance. There is a bench along the way so you can rest while returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。一周を完成させることより、ここから安全に入口へ戻ることを優先します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一周達成より今いる場所から戻る方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will prioritize getting safely back to the entrance from here over completing the loop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that returning from your present location takes priority over finishing the loop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの戻り道をお進みください。池の先へ一周を続けず、途中のベンチで休んでから入口へ戻る経路です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take this return path. It returns to the entrance with a bench to rest at, rather than continuing the loop beyond the pond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many people will be traveling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と子どもです。子どもは無料と聞いたので、一席ずつ使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子が無料なら各一席使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child and me. I heard children travel free, so can we each use a seat?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a child traveling free can use a separate seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 年齢や列車、座席の利用に応じて確認が必要です。お子さんの年齢を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check according to age, train and seating. How old is your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五歳です。無料という情報だけで、席も一つ付くと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五歳で無料情報と座席付与を混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Five. I thought free travel meant a seat was included too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your child is five and you confused free travel with an included seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご利用予定の列車を確認します。お子さん専用の席をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the train you plan to use. Would you like a seat just for your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、長い移動なので一席使いたいです。その場合の切符と料金を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子専用席希望とその場合の券料金を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. It is a long journey, so I would like one seat for my child. Please explain the ticket and fare in that case.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a dedicated child seat and the required ticket and fare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件を確認してご案内します。同行する方はほかにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the conditions and explain. Is anyone else traveling with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いません。大人一人と子ども一人で、希望する席は二つです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 人数は大人一子一で希望席二と明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. One adult and one child, and we want two seats.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that there is one adult and one child and you want two seats. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入前に席の条件と合計を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can check the seating conditions and total before purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。年齢による扱いと座席の希望を分けて、確認後に買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 年齢条件と席希望を分け合計確認後に購入すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will consider the age rules separately from the seating request and buy after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish age conditions from seating preferences and buy after checking the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。列車と座席の条件を整理してご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will organize and explain the train and seating conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 回答の提出についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about submitting your response?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、今日が期限なので、仕事が終わる夜に窓口へ持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 期限当日の夜に窓口提出する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The deadline is today, so I will bring it to the counter tonight after work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you plan to submit at the counter on the evening of the deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 窓口の受付時間も確認する必要があります。何時ごろの予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We also need to check the counter’s opening hours. What time are you planning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夜八時です。今日中という日付だけで、夜も受け付けてもらえると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 八時予定で日付だけから夜受付と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Eight tonight. I saw only the date and thought they would accept it at night as long as it was today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you planned on eight and assumed the date allowed evening submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出方法と受付時間を担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check submission methods and opening hours with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。閉まった窓口の前に置けば提出済みとは考えず、可能な方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 閉窓口へ放置せず可能な提出方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not assume leaving it outside a closed counter counts as submission; I want to know an available method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a usable submission method instead of leaving it at a closed counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知にはオンラインや郵送の指定もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does the notice specify online or postal submission too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 方法の欄がありますが、まだ読めていません。今日間に合う方法と条件を担当へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 方法欄未読で当日間に合う条件確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a methods section, but I have not read it yet. I want to ask which method and conditions allow me to meet today’s deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have not read the methods section and ask about conditions for submitting on time today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当につなぎます。用意できている資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will connect you to the person in charge. Do you have the documents ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: あります。ただ、郵送の差出日でよいかも未確認なので、期限の扱いを一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料準備済みで郵送の期限扱いも確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. But I have not checked whether the postal dispatch date counts, so I will check how the deadline is treated too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that the documents are ready and you will also check the postal deadline rule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。日付、受付時間、提出方法の条件を担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. The person in charge will explain the date, opening hours and conditions for each submission method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計がお済みでない方はこちらですが、診察は終わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This line is for people who have not paid yet. Have you finished your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。初めて来たので、人が並んでいる列へ入りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未診察の初診で人の列に並んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. It is my first visit, so I joined the line where people were waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are a first-time patient who has not been seen and joined the queue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診察前の受付と会計は別です。予約の有無を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Registration before care and payment are separate. May I ask whether you have an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約はありません。ここで払えば診察の番号が出ると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約なしで支払いが診察番号発行と思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not. I thought paying here would give me a consultation number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have no appointment and thought payment issued a consultation number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 初診の受付方法を担当へ確認します。先にお支払いはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the first-visit registration procedure. Please do not pay first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。列を離れて、診察を受けたいことを受付へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先払いせず受診希望を初診受付へ伝えると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will leave this line and tell reception I would like to see a clinician.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not pay first and will request care at first-visit reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人確認に使う書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have documents for identity verification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、持っています。会計へ置いた物はまだないので、自分で持って受付へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人書類所持で会計に預けていないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I have not left anything at the payment desk, so I will take them myself to reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have your identification and have not handed anything to the payment desk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 初診窓口の表示をお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will show you the sign for the first-visit counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。次は列の人数ではなく窓口の役割を確かめて並びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人数でなく窓口の役割を確認して並ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Next time I will check the counter’s purpose instead of joining based on the number of people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the counter’s role rather than the queue size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。初診窓口で予約なしの受診方法をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please ask the first-visit counter how to receive care without an appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードはどちらで拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where did you find the card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: スーパーの前です。持ち主を探す投稿を書きましたが、まだ送っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得場所と持主探し投稿が未送信と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Outside a supermarket. I drafted a post to find its owner, but have not sent it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the find location and say the owner-search post is unsent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 投稿にはどのような情報を入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What information did you put in the post?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カードの写真です。番号まで写っているので、載せてよいか聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号入りカード写真の公開可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: A photo of the card. The number is visible too, so I came to ask whether posting it is acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may publish a card photo showing its number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号や個人の情報を公表せず、現物をこちらへお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not publish the number or personal details. Please hand the actual card to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、下書きは送らず削除します。現物はこの封筒に入れて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 公開せず下書きを消し封筒の現物を渡すと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will delete the draft without posting it. I brought the actual card in this envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will delete the unsent draft and hand over the card in its envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのカードを使ったり、機械で確認したりしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you used the card or checked it in a machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: していません。利用できるか試すこともせず、そのままお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 試用や機械照会をしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I have not even tested whether it works; I will hand it over as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have neither tested the card nor checked it in a machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拾った時刻と届けた方の情報を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask when you found it and for information about you as the finder.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 午後一時です。カードに書かれた人の名前と、届けた私の名前を分けて記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拾得時刻を示しカード名義と届出本人を分けて頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: At one in the afternoon. Please record the cardholder’s name separately from my name as the person reporting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the time found and ask to distinguish the cardholder from you as the finder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。カードの扱いと拾った経緯を確認し、届け出をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check how you handled and found the card, then explain the report procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい住所への郵便が届かないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Mail is not arriving at your new address, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、友人へ住所を送りましたが、部屋番号を一三二ではなく一二三と書いたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新住所の部屋番号を逆に伝えた可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I sent a friend my address, but I may have written apartment 123 instead of 132.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you may have reversed digits in the new apartment number you provided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送ったメッセージを確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you check the message you sent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一二三と送っていました。郵便局の転送だけの問題と思っていましたが、私の連絡も違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送信内容で誤番号を確認し転送だけの問題でないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I sent 123. I thought it was only a mail-forwarding issue, but my own message was wrong too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the incorrect number in your message and say it is not just a forwarding issue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人が実際に書いた宛先を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the address your friend actually wrote.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、メッセージと同じとは決めず、封筒の住所を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 差出人が実際に書いた住所を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will ask what is on the envelope, rather than assume it matches my message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the address actually written by the sender. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: すでに発送されているかも分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know whether it has already been sent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 未確認です。まだなら直してもらい、発送済みなら元の郵便の状況を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未発送なら訂正済発送なら状況相談と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. If not, I will ask them to correct it; if it has been sent, I would like to ask about that item’s status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish correction before sending from checking the status after dispatch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報が確認できたら、担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person in charge once you confirm that information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。私の番号を訂正しただけで、発送済みの封筒も変わったことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡訂正で発送済み住所も変わるとはしないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Correcting the number I told my friend does not mean the address on an already-sent envelope has changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that correcting your message does not change an already-sent envelope’s address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。正しい住所、実際の記載、発送状況を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Let us check the correct address, actual written address and dispatch status separately.
